readmodels.title: MyShifts

fields.name: clockInOpensAt
fields.mapping: ShiftCreated.startDateTime minus the 15 minute grace period

fields.name: clockable
fields.mapping: true when the queried moment falls between clockInOpensAt and endDateTime - drives whether the shift is selectable in the UI

readmodels.description: The shifts this employee is assigned to, with the flag that says whether each one can be clocked into right now. A shift is clockable from 15 minutes before its startDateTime until its endDateTime. The employee picks one of these before issuing ClockIn.

specifications.title: an assigned shift is clockable inside the 15 minute grace period
the same shift is not clockable before the grace period opens
a shift the employee is not assigned to is not listed

commands.title: ClockIn

fields.name: clockedInAt
fields.mapping: the moment the employee pressed clock in

fields.name: location
fields.mapping: optional - where the employee clocked in

fields.name: terminal
fields.mapping: optional - which terminal recorded the clock in

commands.description: An employee starts recording work time on a shift they are assigned to. Rejected unless the selected shift is active - clocking in is allowed from 15 minutes before the shift starts until it ends. Rejected if the employee is already clocked in.

events.title: ClockedIn
events.description: An employee started recording work time on a shift.

specifications.title: clocking in to an active shift records the timestamp, location and terminal
clocking in without location or terminal is allowed
clocking in more than 15 minutes before the shift starts is rejected

then.title: clocking in more than 15 minutes before the shift starts is rejected
then.description: shift_not_active - clock in opens 15 minutes before the shift starts, at 05:45

specifications.title: clocking in after the shift has ended is rejected

then.title: clocking in after the shift has ended is rejected

specifications.title: clocking in to a shift the employee is not assigned to is rejected

then.title: clocking in to a shift the employee is not assigned to is rejected
then.description: not_assigned_to_shift - the employee has no EmployeeAssignedToShift for this shift

specifications.title: clocking in while already clocked in is rejected

then.title: clocking in while already clocked in is rejected
then.description: already_clocked_in - the employee has an open ClockedIn with no matching ClockedOut

commands.title: ClockOut

fields.name: clockedOutAt
fields.mapping: the moment the employee pressed clock out

fields.name: location
fields.mapping: optional - where the employee clocked out

fields.name: terminal
fields.mapping: optional - which terminal recorded the clock out

commands.description: An employee stops recording work time. Rejected if the employee is not currently clocked in. Rejected if the clock out moment is not after the clock in moment.

events.title: ClockedOut

fields.name: shiftId
fields.mapping: the shift from the open ClockedIn - carried so the entry is complete without a join

events.description: An employee stopped recording work time on a shift.

specifications.title: clocking out while clocked in records the timestamp and carries the shift
clocking out without ever clocking in is rejected

then.title: clocking out without ever clocking in is rejected
then.description: not_clocked_in - there is no open ClockedIn for this employee

then.title: clocking out twice is rejected
then.description: not_clocked_in - the last ClockedIn was already closed by a ClockedOut

specifications.title: clocking out before the clock in moment is rejected

then.title: clocking out before the clock in moment is rejected
then.description: clock_out_before_clock_in - clockedOutAt must be after the open clockedInAt of 05:52

specifications.title: an employee can clock in again after clocking out

readmodels.title: AttendanceHistory

fields.name: employeeId
fields.mapping: ClockedIn.employeeId - the signed-in employee, an employee only sees their own history

fields.name: month
fields.mapping: the month of ClockedIn.clockedInAt - defaults to the current month

fields.name: clockedOutAt
fields.mapping: ClockedOut.clockedOutAt - absent while the entry is still open

fields.name: hoursWorked
fields.mapping: clockedOutAt minus clockedInAt in hours - absent while the entry is still open

fields.name: monthHoursWorked
fields.mapping: sum of hoursWorked across every closed entry in the queried month - same on every row

readmodels.description: An employee's own attendance history - one row per clock in, with the matching clock out when there is one, plus the hours worked. Scoped to the signed-in employee and filtered to one month, so the page can show the current month's total. A row with no clockedOutAt is a still-open or forgotten clock out.

specifications.title: a closed entry shows the hours worked and counts towards the month total
an entry with no clock out shows no hours and is excluded from the month total
